materialityRule: At each five-minute decision, use the frozen next-half-hour forecast only when the future boundary is inside the 30-minute horizon and |predicted-next proxy minus current proxy| > 11. Otherwise use the same-state persistence decision.
directionalRule: If material forecast indicates more people, compute both decisions from identical current state and observation memory. Reject the forecast decision when it turns off a unit enabled by persistence or raises either enabled unit's device setpoint. The unchanged persistence action remains available.
declineRule: A material predicted decline can select the V2 forecast decision subject to its unchanged sampled-temperature search and device holds. It does not establish an unoccupied zone; all four allocations remain assumptions.
sharedConditions: Same two-unit response model, 22.2-26.8 C occupied / 20-28 C empty room-air acceptance, current weather held, five-minute decisions, 30-minute horizon, 20-minute holds, 15-second nominal integration, initial 24 C, 06:30-22:30, baseline23 and baseline24 retained separately.
terminalRule: Use parent protocol: both modes pass every sampled zone temperature constraint and each four-zone final temperature differs <=0.05 C; otherwise no qualified saving percentage. No end restoration is assumed.
electricity: Nominal 9.18 kW per simulated compressor ON, not measured power or verified part-load consumption.
evaluationRole: Historical replay already inspected in development; no untouched independent control test or field verification. Threshold was not selected using replay savings.
decisionClaim: Training-derived materiality is an engineering guard candidate, not a confidence interval or certified safe control. Never describe a small forecast change as verified spatial vacancy.
